questions.question: Kapil invested ₹1,00,000 in a business. After 3 months, Manish joined with ₹80,000. After 3 more months, Kapil withdrew ₹40,000. Find their profit ratio at the end of the year.
questions.questionHtml: Kapil invested ₹1,00,000 in a business. After 3 months, Manish joined with ₹80,000. After 3 more months, Kapil withdrew ₹40,000. Find their profit ratio at the end of the year.
questions.solution:
Kapil investment for first 6 months = 100000 × 6 = 600000

Kapil investment for next 6 months = 60000 × 6 = 360000

Kapil total = 600000 + 360000 = 960000

Manish total = 80000 × 9 = 720000

Ratio = 960000 : 720000 = 96 : 72 = 4 : 3

questions.question: Three numbers are such that when the sum of any two of them is added to half of the third, the results are 210, 198, and 192 respectively. What is the average of the three numbers?
questions.questionHtml: Three numbers are such that when the sum of any two of them is added to half of the third, the results are 210, 198, and 192 respectively. What is the average of the three numbers?
questions.solution:
<svg width="450" height="280" viewBox="0 0 450 280" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" style="display:block;margin:1px;padding:0;background:#ffffff;border-radius:8px;border:1px solid #cccccc;box-sizing:border-box;">
  <defs>
    <marker id="arr" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="6" markerHeight="6" orient="auto-start-reverse">
      <path d="M0,0 L10,5 L0,10 z" fill="#2255cc"/>
    </marker>
  </defs>

  <!-- ZONE 1: Averages Visual Mechanism -->
  <!-- Base Line -->
  <line x1="40" y1="180" x2="300" y2="180" stroke="#555555" stroke-width="2"/>
  
  <!-- Bar X (Value 100) -->
  <rect x="60" y="100" width="45" height="80" fill="#ddeeff" stroke="#2255cc" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <rect x="60" y="80" width="45" height="20" fill="#ccffcc" stroke="#007700" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <text x="75" y="195" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" fill="#222222">x</text>
  
  <!-- Bar Y (Value 80 - The Average) -->
  <rect x="130" y="100" width="45" height="80" fill="#ddeeff" stroke="#2255cc" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <text x="145" y="195" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" fill="#222222">y</text>
  
  <!-- Bar Z (Value 60) -->
  <rect x="200" y="120" width="45" height="60" fill="#ddeeff" stroke="#2255cc" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <rect x="200" y="100" width="45" height="20" fill="#ffd6d6" stroke="#cc0000" stroke-dasharray="3,2" stroke-width="1"/>
  <text x="215" y="195" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" fill="#222222">z</text>

  <!-- Average Level Line -->
  <line x1="40" y1="100" x2="320" y2="100" stroke="#cc0000" stroke-width="2" stroke-dasharray="5,4"/>
  <text x="325" y="105" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" fill="#cc0000" font-weight="700">Avg = 80</text>
  
  <!-- Labels for Deviations -->
  <text x="55" y="70" font-family="Arial" font-size="12" fill="#007700">+ Deviation</text>
  <text x="195" y="90" font-family="Arial" font-size="12" fill="#cc0000">− Deviation</text>

  <!-- ZONE 2: Solution Lines -->
  <text x="30" y="220" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" fill="#222222">⇒ 2.5 × (x + y + z) = 210 + 198 + 192 = 600</text>
  <text x="30" y="245" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" fill="#222222">⇒ Sum (x + y + z) = 600 ÷ 2.5 = 240</text>
  
  <!-- Final Answer -->
  <text x="30" y="270" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" font-weight="700" fill="#000000">∴ Answer = 80</text>
</svg>

questions.question: In a competitive exam with 120 questions, there are three sections: General Knowledge (20 questions), Reasoning (50 questions), and English (50 questions). A candidate answered 70% of General Knowledge, 50% of Reasoning, and 30% of English questions correctly. If the minimum passing score is 60%, how many more questions did the candidate need to answer correctly to pass?
questions.questionHtml: In a competitive exam with 120 questions, there are three sections: General Knowledge (20 questions), Reasoning (50 questions), and English (50 questions). A candidate answered 70% of General Knowledge, 50% of Reasoning, and 30% of English questions correctly. If the minimum passing score is 60%, how many more questions did the candidate need to answer correctly to pass?

    <marker id="arrG" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="6" markerHeight="6" orient="auto-start-reverse"><path d="M0,0 L10,5 L0,10 z" fill="#007700"/></marker>

questions.question: Find the compound interest on ₹7,000 at 9% p.a. for 1 year 8 months, compounded annually.
questions.questionHtml: Find the compound interest on ₹7,000 at 9% p.a. for 1 year 8 months, compounded annually.
questions.solution:
<svg width="500" height="260" viewBox="0 0 500 260" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" style="display:block;margin:1px;background:#ffffff;border-radius:8px;border:1px solid #cccccc;box-sizing:border-box;">
  <defs>
    <marker id="arr" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="6" markerHeight="6" orient="auto-start-reverse">
      <path d="M0,0 L10,5 L0,10 z" fill="#555555"/>
    </marker>
  </defs>

  <!-- ZONE 1: COMPOUND INTEREST TIMELINE -->
  <!-- Principal Base -->
  <rect x="40" y="110" width="420" height="25" fill="#ddeeff" stroke="#2255cc" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <text x="210" y="128" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" fill="#2255cc">Principal (P) = ₹7,000</text>

  <!-- Interest Tiles -->
  <!-- Year 1 (9%) -->
  <rect x="40" y="65" width="250" height="45" fill="#ccffcc" stroke="#007700" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <text x="110" y="92" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" fill="#007700">Year 1 (9%) = ₹630</text>

  <!-- 8 Months (6%) -->
  <rect x="290" y="75" width="170" height="35" fill="#fff0cc" stroke="#cc5500" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <text x="305" y="96" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" fill="#cc5500">8m (6%) = ₹457.8</text>

  <!-- Timeline Baseline -->
  <line x1="40" y1="145" x2="460" y2="145" stroke="#555555" stroke-width="2" marker-end="url(#arr)"/>
  <line x1="40" y1="140" x2="40" y2="150" stroke="#555555" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="290" y1="140" x2="290" y2="150" stroke="#555555" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="460" y1="140" x2="460" y2="150" stroke="#555555" stroke-width="2"/>
  
  <text x="35" y="165" font-family="Arial" font-size="12" fill="#555555">0</text>
  <text x="275" y="165" font-family="Arial" font-size="12" fill="#555555">1 Year</text>
  <text x="415" y="165" font-family="Arial" font-size="12" fill="#555555">1 Yr 8 Months</text>

  <!-- Total CI Bracket -->
  <path d="M40,55 Q40,40 250,40 T460,55" fill="none" stroke="#222222" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <text x="210" y="30" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" font-weight="700" fill="#000000">Total CI</text>

  <!-- ZONE 2: CALCULATION -->
  <text x="30" y="195" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" fill="#222222">⇒ Rate for 8 months = 9% × (8 ÷ 12) = 6%</text>
  <text x="30" y="218" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" fill="#222222">⇒ Total CI = 630 + 6% of (7000 + 630) = 630 + 457.80</text>
  
  <text x="30" y="245" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" font-weight="700" fill="#000000">∴ Answer = ₹1,087.80</text>
</svg>

questions.solution:
<svg width="450" height="260" viewBox="0 0 450 260" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" style="display:block;margin:1px;padding:0;background:#ffffff;border-radius:8px;border:1px solid #cccccc;box-sizing:border-box;">

  <!-- ZONE 1: COMPOUND INTEREST STEPS -->

</svg>

He mixes them in the ratio 3 : 4 : 3. If he sells all the notebooks at 4 for ₹19, what is his approximate gain or loss percentage?

<svg width="550" height="280" viewBox="0 0 550 280" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" style="display:block;margin:1px;background:#ffffff;border-radius:8px;border:1px solid #cccccc;box-sizing:border-box;">

  <!-- ZONE 1: Proportional CP Bars & Comparison -->
  <!-- Base Ground -->
  <line x1="40" y1="160" x2="380" y2="160" stroke="#555555" stroke-width="2"/>

  <text x="260" y="90" font-family="Arial" font-size="12" fill="#008080">CP: ₹4.5</text>
  <text x="275" y="175" font-family="Arial" font-size="12" fill="#222222">Ratio: 3</text>

  <!-- Avg CP and SP markers -->
  <line x1="340" y1="73" x2="410" y2="73" stroke="#888888" stroke-dasharray="5,3" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <text x="415" y="78" font-family="Arial" font-size="12" fill="#555555">Avg CP = ₹4.35</text>
  
  <line x1="340" y1="65" x2="410" y2="65" stroke="#007700" stroke-width="2"/>
  <text x="415" y="60" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" font-weight="700" fill="#007700">SP = ₹4.75</text>

questions.question: A and B can complete a task in 12 days and 18 days, respectively. They begin the work together, but B leaves after 4 days. How many more days will A take to finish the remaining work?
questions.questionHtml: A and B can complete a task in 12 days and 18 days, respectively. They begin the work together, but B leaves after 4 days. How many more days will A take to finish the remaining work?
questions.solution:
⇒ LCM of 12 and 18 = 36

⇒ Total work = 36 units, A's 1-day work = 36 ÷ 12 = 3 units, B's 1-day work = 36 ÷ 18 = 2 units

⇒ Work done together per day = 3 + 2 = 5 units

⇒ Work done in 4 days = 5 × 4 = 20 units

⇒ Remaining work = 36 − 20 = 16 units

⇒ Days taken by A alone = 16 ÷ 3 = 5 (1)/(3)

<svg width="520" height="260" viewBox="0 0 520 260" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" style="display:block;margin:1px;padding:0;background:#ffffff;border-radius:8px;border:1px solid #cccccc;box-sizing:border-box;">

  <text x="30" y="210" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" fill="#222222">⇒ Time Ratio (T₁ : T₂) = 105 : 120 = 7 : 8</text>
  <text x="30" y="230" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" fill="#222222">⇒ Speed Ratio (S₁ : S₂) = 8 : 7 (since Distance is constant)</text>
  <text x="30" y="255" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" font-weight="700" fill="#000000">∴ Answer = 0.125</text>
</svg>

questions.question: A student walks from his home to school at a speed of 4 km/h and reaches 15 minutes late. If he increases his speed to 6 km/h, he reaches 5 minutes early. What is the distance (in km) from his home to school?
questions.questionHtml: A student walks from his home to school at a speed of 4 km/h and reaches 15 minutes late. If he increases his speed to 6 km/h, he reaches 5 minutes early. What is the distance (in km) from his home to school?
questions.solution:
<svg width="500" height="260" viewBox="0 0 500 260" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" style="display:block;margin:1px;background:#ffffff;border-radius:8px;border:1px solid #cccccc;box-sizing:border-box;">
  <defs>
    <marker id="arr" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="6" markerHeight="6" orient="auto-start-reverse"><path d="M0,0 L10,5 L0,10 z" fill="#2255cc"/></marker>
    <marker id="arrG" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="6" markerHeight="6" orient="auto-start-reverse"><path d="M0,0 L10,5 L0,10 z" fill="#007700"/></marker>
    <marker id="arrO" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="6" markerHeight="6" orient="auto-start-reverse"><path d="M0,0 L10,5 L0,10 z" fill="#cc5500"/></marker>
  </defs>

  <!-- ZONE 1: Speed/Distance Mechanism -->
  <!-- Home and School icons -->
  <path d="M30,110 L30,135 L60,135 L60,110 L45,95 Z" fill="#f0f0f0" stroke="#555555" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <text x="32" y="150" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" fill="#555555">Home</text>
  
  <rect x="410" y="100" width="50" height="35" fill="#f0f0f0" stroke="#555555" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <path d="M410,100 L435,80 L460,100" fill="#f0f0f0" stroke="#555555" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <text x="412" y="150" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" fill="#555555">School</text>

  <!-- Road -->
  <line x1="60" y1="135" x2="410" y2="135" stroke="#555555" stroke-width="4"/>
  <line x1="70" y1="135" x2="400" y2="135" stroke="#ffffff" stroke-width="1" stroke-dasharray="5,5"/>

  <!-- Speed 1: 4 km/h -->
  <path d="M80,75 Q245,60 390,75" fill="none" stroke="#2255cc" stroke-width="2" marker-end="url(#arr)"/>
  <text x="180" y="55" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" fill="#2255cc">4 km/h (15 min Late)</text>

  <!-- Speed 2: 6 km/h -->
  <path d="M80,45 Q245,20 390,45" fill="none" stroke="#007700" stroke-width="2" marker-end="url(#arrG)"/>
  <text x="180" y="25" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" fill="#007700">6 km/h (5 min Early)</text>

  <!-- Time Gap Visualization -->
  <line x1="150" y1="105" x2="350" y2="105" stroke="#888888" stroke-width="1" stroke-dasharray="3,2"/>
  <circle cx="250" cy="105" r="3" fill="#555555"/> <!-- Ideal point -->
  <text x="235" y="120" font-family="Arial" font-size="12" fill="#555555">Ideal</text>
  
  <line x1="200" y1="105" x2="310" y2="105" stroke="#cc0000" stroke-width="2"/>
  <text x="160" y="100" font-family="Arial" font-size="12" fill="#cc5500">-5m</text>
  <text x="315" y="100" font-family="Arial" font-size="12" fill="#cc0000">+15m</text>
  
  <path d="M200,95 L200,85 M310,95 L310,85" stroke="#cc0000" stroke-width="1"/>
  <text x="215" y="85" font-family="Arial" font-size="13" fill="#cc0000">Gap = 20 min</text>

  <!-- ZONE 2: Solution -->
  <text x="30" y="185" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" fill="#222222">⇒ Total Time Difference = 15 + 5 = 20 min = 1/3 hr</text>
  <text x="30" y="210" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" fill="#222222">⇒ Distance = [ (s1 × s2) ÷ (s2 − s1) ] × Time Gap = (4 × 6 ÷ 2) × 1/3</text>
  
  <text x="30" y="245" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" font-weight="700" fill="#000000">∴ Answer = 4 km</text>
</svg>

questions.question: The cost of fencing a circular ground at ₹120/m is ₹3,768. Find the radius of the ground.
questions.questionHtml: The cost of fencing a circular ground at ₹120/m is ₹3,768. Find the radius of the ground.
questions.solution:
Cost of fencing ÷ Rate of fencing ⇒ Circumference

3768 ÷ 120 ⇒ 31.4

2 × π × r = 31.4 ⇒ r = 31.4 ÷ (2 × 3.14) ⇒ r = 5 m

questions.question: A circular clock has a radius of 14 cm. Calculate the distance covered by the tip of the minute hand in 30 minutes, assuming it is positioned at the edge of the clock face? (Use π= 22/7)
questions.questionHtml: A circular clock has a radius of 14 cm. Calculate the distance covered by the tip of the minute hand in 30 minutes, assuming it is positioned at the edge of the clock face? (Use π= 22/7)
questions.solution:
⇒ Circumference = 2 × (22 ÷ 7) × 14

⇒ Circumference = 88 cm

⇒ Distance in 30 minutes = 88 ÷ 2 = 44 cm

questions.questionHtml: What is the slope of line perpendicular to y = -3x + 7?
questions.solution:
⇒ Slope of given line = −3

⇒ Slope of perpendicular line = −1 ÷ (−3)

⇒ Slope of perpendicular line = 1 ÷ 3
